# CyberCubeachievesISO27001accreditation

CyberCube has achieved the ISO 27001 accreditation

- Jan 18 2022

- 1 Minute Read

San Francisco, 18 January 2022 –

CyberCube, the market-leading cyber analytics provider, has been awarded ISO 27001 certification.

ISO 27001 is the international standard that lays out the specifications for implementing an information security management system. Adhering to these specifications enables organisations to manage the security of assets such as financial information, intellectual property, employee details and information entrusted by third parties.

The awarding of the certification confirms CyberCube’s commitment to compliance and best practices in regard to its policies, procedures, and security.

Peter Quinby, CyberCube’s Business Operations Lead, said: "Achieving ISO 27001 certification is an important milestone for us. It shows our commitment to our clients’ security and reinforces our trustworthiness.

“Combined with our ongoing [SOC2 Type 2 attestation](https://www.cybcube.com/news/cybercube-soc-2-accreditation), this really demonstrates the emphasis we place on keeping our data and our clients’ safe from intrusion.”
